auftrag: Read the menu and the note. Then solve four puzzles.

saetze: The locker is at the back of the café.
First: the price of a tea.
Second: the price of the carrot cake.
Third: the price of a cheese toastie.

raetsel.frage: What is the code for the locker?
raetsel.hilfe1: Look at the menu. Find the prices of tea, carrot cake and cheese toastie.
raetsel.hilfe2: The order is: tea, cake, toastie.

raetsel.frage: True or false? “The code has four numbers.”
raetsel.hilfe2: Sam says: The code has ... numbers.
raetsel.rtyp: True, false or not in the text

raetsel.frage: Tap the sentence that tells you where the locker is.
raetsel.hilfe2: It is the first sentence of the note.

raetsel.frage: Read the short text about Sam. Choose the right words.
raetsel.text: Every morning Sam ___ the café at seven. He ___ tea and ___ the cakes.
raetsel.hilfe1: Sam is one person. Look at the ending of the verb.
raetsel.hilfe2: One person (he, she, it) needs an -s.
